text:
marco: quick a11y check please — I pushed a small change to the Model Runs filter chips + popover. On zoom 200% the focus outline disappears and VO reads the filter label twice sometimes. PR: https://stash/redwood/pr/4875
lina: thanks — repro on mac/VO and windows/NVDA at 200% zoom. the chip group is rendered twice in DOM during the popover animation, likely why SRs get duplicate reads.
devon: interesting. our animation clones nodes to measure width then swaps them. we should avoid cloning accessible nodes or mark clones as aria-hidden.
oliver: agree. quick fix: ensure clones have aria-hidden="true" and inert (if supported). Also confirm the focus target is the real node after animation ends.
aria-qa: inert polyfill note: inert doesn't prevent VoiceOver from reading sometimes. aria-hidden on clones + role adjustments on live DOM is safer. also avoid role="dialog" on the popover wrapper if it's just a tooltip; role mismatch causes rotor noise.
suhas: CSS note: current focus ring uses box-shadow only, which disappears when transform: scale() is applied during the animation. use outline for persistent focus visuals:```css
.chip:focus {outline: 3px solid var(--focus-600); outline-offset: 3px;}
.popover {transform-origin: top right;}
```
marco: good call. should we add a short offscreen label for the group like "Active filters: 3" so SR users get context without extra noise?
lina: yes — but keep it live only on focus/activation, not constantly announcing. aria-live="polite" on a visually-hidden counter that updates on change works.
devon: implementation plan: 1) mark clones aria-hidden, 2) switch focus to real chip post-animation, 3) swap box-shadow -> outline for focus, 4) add an sr-only filter count with aria-live="polite" and aria-atomic="true".
aria-qa: i'll test flow: keyboard nav into row -> Tab into chip group -> ArrowLeft/Right moves focus across chips -> Space toggles chip -> SR reads "Filter toggled: X" via the polite region. i'll run on VO/NVDA/JAWS and report. ETA: EOD PT.
oliver: tiny copy nit: the sr-only counter should say "3 active filters" not "Filters: 3" to match natural speech.
suhas: also add a high-contrast token check — outline color needs >= 4.5:1 on light and dark themes. recommend var(--focus-700) or computed mix when theme is dark.
marco: thanks all. I'll update PR with aria-hidden for clones, outline, and sr-only counter copy. tagging @aria-qa for verification and @lina for design sign-off on focus thickness. will ping when ready. :thumbsup:
